prompt:
Research the officially documented free-tier rate limits of the Google Gemini API (requests per minute and per day) for its current models. Cite Google's documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, here is what I found regarding the free-tier rate limits of the Google Gemini API.

## What the documentation says about rate limits in general

The Gemini API rate limits are measured across three dimensions: Requests per minute (RPM), Tokens per minute (input) (TPM), and Requests per day (RPD). The documentation states that limits vary by model and tier, and directs users to AI Studio to view their actual active rate limits. Notably, the documentation says that "Specified rate limits are not guaranteed and actual capacity may vary."

## What specific numbers I could and could not find

The provided search results do **not** contain the specific free-tier RPM and RPD numbers for each Gemini model. The documentation repeatedly directs users to "View your active rate limits in AI Studio" and states "For details on those rate limits, see the AI Studio Rate Limit page" — but that AI Studio rate limit page was not included in the search results.

I did find some grounding-specific free-tier RPD limits on the pricing page (e.g., 500 RPD for Google Search grounding on Gemini 2.5 Flash), but these are not the general API request rate limits the task is asking about.

SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits | QUOTE: "Rate limits are applied per project, not per API key. Requests per day (RPD) quotas reset at midnight Pacific time." | CLAIM: Rate limits apply per project and RPD quotas reset at midnight Pacific time.

For details on those rate limits, see the AI Studio Rate Limit page." | CLAIM: Specific per-model RPM numbers are documented on the AI Studio Rate Limit page, which was not included in the search results.
